correctness.rationale: The Feynman-Kac equation u″=z^2 u, half-line Green kernel and independent-reset renewal yield E tau=(L^2/D)lambda^-2 integral_0^lambda I/u^2. The nonstandard uniqueness lemma is reconstructed: a=-u′/u has 0<a′<1; b=I/u and H=(3a^2-z^2)b-3a/2 satisfy h″=2H/u; H is positive at zero and infinity, while at every putative positive zero H′<0, so H>0. Thus F=lambda h-2m has F″=lambda h″>0, F′(0)<0 and F->infinity, hence exactly one positive zero and a global minimum. The supplied FD numerical script checks five independent generator instances with quadratic mesh convergence. Decimals are not certified interval enclosures.

value.rationale: The motivating informed resetting research explicitly identifies the analytical optimum for quadratic spatial reset intensity as missing and presents only a numerical estimate. Exact unique global optimal curvature and dimensional scaling answer that physically motivated design question, distinguish a global minimum from local stationary candidates, and supply reproducible non-simulation evaluation. No general finite-sensing-range claim is made.
